statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and fatigue
The patient has symptomatic atrial fibrillation
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is ordered
The study is ordered to optimize rate control and assess for brady-tachy syndrome
The diagnosis codes are I49.5 and I48.91
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the records do not sufficiently demonstrate medical necessity according to coverage criteria
The denial reason is that less intensive monitoring options were not attempted and failed
